$comment: The fort CLI's tool dependencies as one declared set (sfi/forts#25). Two readers: internal/tools checks for a tool at run time and names a missing one, and flake.nix puts the packaged set on packages.fort's wrapper PATH and in devShells.default. `packaged` maps a binary to the nixpkgs attribute path that carries it. `ambient` is the binary the host must own: `attr` is what an operator installs it from, `why` is the reason the closure must not carry it. Declare a tool here before you exec it.

nix.why: it is the client of the host's own daemon; `image` builds with it, `check --eval` evaluates with it

pulumi.why: pulumi loads its bundled go language host from the directory of its own binary, so it must stay the distribution the operator installed; and the CLI sets PULUMI_IGNORE_AMBIENT_PLUGINS, which makes a pulumi on a wrapper's PATH ignore every plugin beside it anyway
